title: Non-anchor mirror-pair prediction
rationale: Predeclare a physical-symmetry target from registered sculpture context before any future non-anchor observation scoring. This is a distinct structural target, not another candidate-word or public-fragment mining pass.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should show enrichment or closure among one-based mirror pairs across the 97-character axis if physical front/back orientation is relevant.
discovery_inputs: Registered CIA source-review context for the physical copper screen and back-side chart orientation
Predeclared one-based mirror rule: position i pairs with position 98-i
evaluation_inputs: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-backed position sets not used to construct the mirror-pair artifact
controls: seeded null over sampled non-anchor position sets
multiple-comparison correction if evaluated beside period or spacing families
validate-mirror-observations and evaluate-mirror-prediction required before interpreting source-backed observations
